The actual order date remains in conflict; the constraint was temporary suspension rather than permanent extinction. Conditional agency activation and CBA protection may narrow affected applications.

research_rationale: Every frozen scope is mapped to its legal provision in LIFECYCLE_ANALYSIS.v3.json. This preserves the prior producer analysis while adding actual performance, judicial suspension, conditional CBA applications and separate regulatory consequences. Native exact first-ending fields remain unset where a composite duty, unknown performance date or injunction episode prevents a single supported date. The later formal revocation is retained as a confirmed proposed later event. No automatic revival is inferred from EO 14148. New sources require integration and independent review; approved remains false. The new source review verifies NTIA petition content and binds judicial/OPM findings to actual retained raw bytes and local text spans.

savings.reason: Original CBA protections, the 2019 conditional amendment and statutory rights limit applications. CBAs, personnel actions, retained data, accrued claims and independently issued regulations can have legal consequences after EO command extinction. The March 5, 2021 OPM memorandum requires separate rollback and continues some submissions under independent authority. No evidence exhausts all residual consequences through the cutoff.
